purpose: Record the observed ACIS 21500 pcurve reference-row shapes and the bounded rooted-graph dependency handling added for them.

sourceScreen.origin: Three source-distinct 3DSOLID inline SAB payloads extracted from the local AC1024 conference-room drawing; external DWG/SAB files were not added to the repository.
sourceScreen.method: Scratch-only SAB parser inspection compared each resolved DRW_AcisNode.refs row with its ordered raw pointer tokens and node types.

observation.width2Meaning: common attribute pointer plus one nullable pcurve body pointer
observation.width3Meaning: common attribute pointer plus one nullable body pointer plus one pointer resolving to intcurve-curve
observation.scope: Structural observations for these three payloads only; not a normative ACIS 21500 schema or semantic interpretation of pcurve body fields.

behavior: The ACIS 21500 rooted-view builder accepts only pcurve rows with exactly two or three raw references including the common attribute pointer.
For three-reference rows, the optional final target must resolve to an intcurve-curve node.
The normalized 21800 walker retains the source-profile flag and follows the optional curve edge, including it as an unsupported reachable curve rather than interpreting its geometry.
Public graph-link pointer ordinals are restored to the original ACIS 21500 source rows.
generatedControls: A generated in-memory pcurve with an intcurve-curve dependency produces the pcurve graph link at source pointer ordinal 2 and reports both nodes as unsupported semantics.
A generated in-memory pcurve with a null optional curve dependency remains accepted and reports no reachable curve dependency.
A truncated pcurve pointer row is rejected atomically.
A pcurve dependency resolving to the wrong record type is rejected atomically.

independentTypedAccessorScreen.method: The pinned SatDocument parser and SatPCurve/SatCoedge typed accessors were run against the exact SAT v1 text projections corresponding to the three source SAB payloads. No profile-specific pointer or token normalization was applied.
independentTypedAccessorScreen.disposition: Negative qualification result only. The parser accepts the SAT document framing, but its ACIS-7 typed pcurve/coedge accessor route does not interpret this ACIS 21.5 profile. Do not promote semantic support or infer 21.5 field offsets from this peer.

formatAuthorityBoundary.source: Open Design Alliance, Working with .sat and .sab Files in Teigha
formatAuthorityBoundary.observation: The article maps R24/AutoCAD 2010 to ACIS 21500 and describes Autodesk's 20800-and-later SAT/SAB streams as modified from native Spatial ACIS.
formatAuthorityBoundary.effect: ACIS 7.0 SAT parsing is not an oracle for this modified 21500 profile. Keep pcurve field layout and geometry semantics unqualified until version-specific authority or an explicitly 21500-qualified peer resolves them.

sourcePayloadProjection.result: PASS for all three payloads: 22/22 pcurves reachable and exactly three pcurve-to-intcurve graph links projected per payload.

unresolved: The embedded exp_par_cur and nubs fields are not decoded or independently interpreted.
The pinned ACIS-7 typed pcurve accessors do not decode or link pcurves in these 21500 projections; a version/profile-aware independent route is still needed.
Trim parameterization, surface correspondence, periodicity, and B-rep validity remain unqualified.
The observed pointer-row shape is not established for other ACIS 21500 producers or revisions.
No native CAD acceptance, whole-source output, or general DWG/DXF support claim follows.
claimEffect: Adds bounded structural closure for an optional ACIS 21500 pcurve-to-intcurve graph dependency. Pcurves and curves remain semantically unsupported; no geometry or support claim is promoted.
